data.one_liner: Dart implementation of ONVIF IP camera and NVR client for device control and streaming.
data.what_it_does: Allows Dart and Flutter applications to integrate with a variety of ONVIF compatible devices, such as IP cameras and network video recorders (NVRs). It supports device management, PTZ (pan-tilt-zoom) control, preset management, imaging, and streaming controls.
use_when: You need to connect and control ONVIF-compliant IP cameras or NVRs in Flutter or Dart.
You need to manage pan-tilt-zoom (PTZ) camera movements and presets programmatically.
You want to retrieve device information, stream URIs, and network settings from security cameras.
avoid_when: You are streaming standard media files or non-ONVIF video sources.
You only need local device camera access rather than remote network IP cameras.
strengths: Comprehensive coverage of ONVIF operations including Device Management, Media, PTZ, Imaging, and Recording.
Provides low-level request fallbacks for custom ONVIF operations.
weaknesses: Requires proper authentication and network privileges (such as Administrator access) on the ONVIF device to avoid unexpected errors.
Relies on specific device implementations which can occasionally introduce ONVIF protocol inconsistencies.
data.setup_notes: Add the dependency to pubspec.yaml and connect to the ONVIF device using host, username, and password credentials.
